verdict.description: take only if this is a real defect with a located cause and a bounded fix

confidence.description: how sure you are that the root cause below is the actual cause

root_cause.description: file:line plus the mechanism, or an explanation of why you could not find one

files_to_change.description: repo-relative paths the fix would touch, excluding new test files

test_plan.description: the specific test that would fail before the fix and pass after

risk.description: low means the blast radius is one module and the behaviour change is local
